# Brand survey with an observed mediator: the numeric recommend rating
# is predicted by quality and value and predicts the service factor and
# one of its ordered indicators (s3), so it is an observed inner
# variable (lavaan's ov.y dummy latent; s3 becomes one too).
quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3
value =~ v1 + v2 + v3
service =~ s1 + s2 + s3
recommend ~ quality + value
service ~ recommend
s3 ~ recommend
